name: financial-invoice-system
description: 命令入口：不安装依赖。前端依赖在 frontend/，后端依赖在 backend/requirements.txt。

scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && node frontend/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c frontend/eslint.config.mjs scripts netsuite
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:web && npm run test:netsuite && npm run test:api
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.check:architecture: npm --prefix frontend run check:architecture && node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest backend/tests/test_architecture.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:api && npm run typecheck && npm run check:architecture && npm run format:check && npm test
